about.title: What this does
about.body: disalytics reads a match demo and lets you review it: the players on the map, the round on the timeline, and every kill, grenade and buy in its place. Everything happens on this device — no demo is ever uploaded. A demo you have opened once opens again straight away, out of this device's own cache. The point is to compress a forty-minute match into a review of about ten.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.note: Keys do nothing while you are typing in a field, and the round timeline reads the arrow keys itself while it has focus.
